Name: Little River Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[b]Special thanks to shekurika for fixing the warps for me :D[/b]

May I present: The Little River Farm. A neat little farm, inspired by Daisyniko's lovely Little Garden Farm. 
A farm for those who like to take things slow without having to limit themselves too much.

Please start a new save on this map, otherwise your greenhouse might be at an odd place and you need Robin to move it.

[u]Features[/u]
• All grass is tillable 
• Replaces the Riverland Farm (configurable in the config)

[u][b]Requirements[/b]
[/u]• For 1.5 (no mobile support)
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets

Installation[/b]
[/u]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Little Riverfarm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the Riverland Farm
